title: fix(fields): PeoplePicker rows and tray, and the people chip, draw only the subtitle and avatar fields FLS lets the user read (objectui#10433)
body:
Fixes #10433
Clause-②: no

## What changes

Head `147feb8`, base `8c929e6` (post objectui#10479). The renderer-side FLS rulings objectui#7215 / objectui#7230 say "FLS gates the OUTPUT". objectui#10411 gated `PeoplePicker`'s `$expand`, and that was the only `checkField` read in `PeoplePicker.tsx` (1 on base, 3 now). Three outputs were still drawn straight off the served row. This PR gates them with the family shape the triage named, `!perms.isLoaded || perms.checkField(object, f, 'read')` with `perms` in the memo deps:

- **`PeoplePicker` person rows, subtitle.** A new `readableSubtitleFields` memo filters `subtitleFields` on `objectName` before `PersonRow` draws them. A dotted path is judged by its first segment: that is the field it reads on `objectName`, and the name the `$expand` gate already judges.
- **`PeoplePicker` person rows and `SelectionTray`, avatar.** A new `readableAvatarField` memo passes the avatar field through, or `null` when the policy denies it. `null` is needed because `PersonRow` and `SelectionTray` default an `undefined` avatar field back to `image`. Their `avatarField` prop and `getPersonAvatarUrl`'s parameter now accept `null` and draw no image, only the initials.
- **`LookupField` search-variant chip, avatar.** The chip reads its avatar through the file's existing `fieldReadGate(perms, referenceTo, idField)`. The old read was `opt[avatarField] || opt.image`.
- **H3, decided: both keys are gated**, each by its own name. `image` is a field of the same served row that the option spreads, so a policy can deny it. A readable `image` still stands in for a denied avatar field, and a denied one does not.

The values the picker commits, the records it hands to `onSelectRecords`, and the option `onSelectRecord` receives are unchanged. Nothing is withheld before a policy loads.

Files: 5 source files, 2 new pin files and 1 changeset. `git diff --numstat` from base: `PeoplePicker.tsx` +33/-4, `LookupField.tsx` +18/-1, `PersonRow.tsx` +6/-1, `SelectionTray.tsx` +6/-1, `personDisplay.ts` +7/-3, `PeoplePicker.outputFls-10433.test.tsx` +223, `LookupField.chipAvatarFls-10433.test.tsx` +177, `.changeset/10433-peoplepicker-fls-outputs.md` +30 (a `patch` for `@object-ui/fields`).

## Pins

Both pins run against the real role-based `PermissionProvider`, not a stub, on a backend that does not strip denied keys. happy-dom never loads an image, so Radix `AvatarImage` renders no `img` either way, and a "no img" assertion would pass on the defect too. Each pin file installs a `LoadedImage` double on `window.Image` and restores it afterwards. With it, an `img` renders exactly when an avatar URL reached the Avatar, and each control asserts that `img`.

- `PeoplePicker.outputFls-10433.test.tsx`, 6 tests:
  - with `email` and `image` denied, a row shows neither and can still be chosen (`onSelect` gets `u1`);
  - a custom `avatarField` is judged by its own name;
  - a subtitle path through a denied relation is not drawn, even from a backend that expands it anyway;
  - the tray's avatar obeys the policy;
  - control: an open policy draws everything;
  - control: no provider draws everything.
- `LookupField.chipAvatarFls-10433.test.tsx` (through `UserField`), 5 tests:
  - a denied `image` is not drawn, and the chip, its label and its initials stay;
  - with `photo` and `image` both denied, nothing is drawn;
  - with only `photo` denied, `image` is drawn;
  - control: an open policy draws everything;
  - control: no provider draws everything.

**Red first, on base sources (H1, measured by render):** before any implementation existed, the two pin files ran against the base sources. Result: `Tests 7 failed | 4 passed (11)`. The failures show the leak itself:
- `expected 'Amy Lin555-0100 · amy@x.io' not to contain 'amy@x.io'`
- `expected 'Amy LinSales · amy@x.io' not to contain 'Sales'`
- `expected 'http://x/amy.png' to be null`

**Green at `147feb8`:** `Tests 11 passed (11)`.

**Ablations at `147feb8`**, three legs through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode, restore trap armed). Every leg reports `anchor 1 -> 0` (leg 3: `2 -> 0`), the blob changed, and it was restored with `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. After all legs the tree diff against HEAD is 0 bytes.

| Leg | Mutation | Result | Red tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | chip fallback read ungated: `drawn('image')` becomes `opt?.image` | `2 failed / 9 passed` | the default-`image` chip; the `photo` + `image` both-denied chip |
| 2 | row subtitle ungated: `subtitleFields={readableSubtitleFields}` becomes `subtitleFields={subtitleFields}` | `2 failed / 9 passed` | the `email` row; the relation-path row |
| 3 | row and tray avatar ungated: both `avatarField={readableAvatarField}` become `avatarField={avatarField}` | `3 failed / 8 passed` | the row; the custom avatar field; the tray |

Every leg's failures are red, in the expected direction.

## Local gates (all at `147feb8`)

- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/fields --concurrency=2`: exit 0, `Tasks: 12 successful, 12 total`. That is the 11 upstream builds plus `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both new pin files (2 of 2; control `PeoplePicker.expandFls-10373.test.tsx` 1).
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 7 changed source and test files (plain form):
  - exit 0, 0 errors;
  - `--format json` reports 7 files linted, none ignored;
  - warnings in the 5 source files against base copies linted under the same config: `LookupField.tsx` 56 to 54, the other four unchanged;
  - the config is not type-aware (`parserOptions.project` and `projectService` both undefined in `--print-config`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Exit 0, each run on its own: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations, report-only), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (7 source files, 1 changeset declared).
- Added from the actual diff, also exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, and `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 8 paths (NOT GOVERNED).
- No i18n strings were added, so `check:i18n-keys` / `check:i18n-drift` were not run.
- **Consumer sweep: not run, because the public surface is unchanged.** I built `@object-ui/fields` twice, once at HEAD and once with base copies of the 5 sources (restored, blob == HEAD):
  - 82 `.d.ts` each; 4 differ: `PeoplePicker`, `PersonRow`, `SelectionTray`, `personDisplay`;
  - no emitted `.d.ts` imports those 4 (control: `index.d.ts` re-exports `LookupField`);
  - `git grep` outside `packages/fields` finds no importer of them (control: `LookupField` has hits);
  - `LookupField.d.ts` is byte-identical.

## Acceptance notes

- **H2 confirmed.** `PeoplePicker`'s one `checkField` on base was the `$expand` filter. The new memos read the same `perms`.
- **Not in this PR (the claim excluded it):** the chip label's fallback to `opt[displayField]` when the built label is empty. No pin here denies the display field, so it was not observed live.
- **Residual, reproduced and not fixed.** `PersonRow` and `SelectionTray` still draw the person's NAME from a display field the policy denies. A throwaway probe (not committed) denied `name` on `sys_user` and saw the row read `Amy Lin`. The tray reads the name through the same `getPersonName` (source read). The chip label, by contrast, is gated since objectui#10411. This is outside the card's three outputs, and it needs a choice about what the row falls back to, so it goes to the seat.
- **Residual, source read only.** The read-only user cell renderer in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` (`UserCellRenderer`) draws `image` and `name` off an expanded user with no FLS read. That file is in another seat's in-flight surface.
- **Divergence, observation only.** The chip falls back to `image`, while the row and the tray read only the configured avatar field.
- **Boundary.** A dotted path's nested segment, such as `name` on the business unit, is not judged on the related object: `PeoplePicker` does not know the relation's target. That is the same boundary as its `$expand` gate.
- **Docs.** No README or guide page describes `PeoplePicker`'s field-level security behaviour, and objectui#10411 added none, so none was added here.
